title: Customer Experience
summary: Customer service and retention roles at Atech Network Systems and Sutherland, then Foodhub — talking directly to customers, understanding why they were unhappy, and fixing it before they left.

achievements.problem: Retention and customer-service work meant understanding what a customer actually needed, not just what they said on the surface.
achievements.action: Handled day-to-day retention, sales, and customer-service conversations across three roles, including pilot initiatives and coaching work at Sutherland.
achievements.result: Built the habit of asking what a number or a complaint is actually for before trusting it — the instinct that later shaped how I approach data and reporting work.

title: Workforce & Operations
summary: Workforce Management Analyst at Foodhub — forecasting contact-centre demand, analyzing agent utilization across queues, and investigating service-level and staffing gaps.

achievements.problem: Operations leadership needed to know, ahead of time, whether staffing on a given shift could handle the expected workload.
achievements.action: Built forecasts and utilization analysis across queues, and investigated root causes when service levels or staffing fell short.
achievements.result: Turned 'what does this data mean for a decision someone has to make today' from an abstract question into the actual day-to-day job — the bridge from operations into analytics.

title: Business Intelligence
summary: BI Analyst at Foodhub — automated dashboards and reports, analyzed revenue/customer-behaviour/platform trends, and authored the majority of the organization's production QuickSight datasets.

achievements.problem: Dashboards and reporting datasets across workforce operations, merchant retention, orders, and quality assurance were each built and maintained individually, with no single person owning reliability across them.
achievements.action: Authored and maintained 100+ production QuickSight datasets against the shared Redshift warehouse, several combining 50+ source tables in one query, alongside SQL query optimization and validation work.
achievements.result: That BI work now reaches 150+ downstream dashboards and 300+ analyses across the organization — platform-wide reach, not just a handful of personal dashboards.

title: Data platform and automation
summary: BI Specialist at Foodhub — monthly performance insights for senior leadership, plus designing and building the data platform and automation the team now runs on.

achievements.problem: Every operational team calculated KPIs with a different, mostly manual method — some using spreadsheets, one using an entirely different point-based scoring system instead of a percentage one.
achievements.action: Designed one standardized Combined Performance Score methodology and built the automated pipeline that runs it, end to end, including a dbt pipeline I own and the data platform it runs on.
achievements.result: Replaced the fragmented, manual process with one standardized pipeline, freeing close to a full headcount per team — full story in the KPI Scoring Pipeline case study.
